text: *Draft 2:* Last week, our local library’s app crashed exactly when a highly anticipated memoir dropped, leaving thousands of readers unable to download their e-books. A sudden server sync error had thrown the digital queue into limbo. Fortunately, the IT team worked through the night to resolve the de-sync and clear the cache. By Saturday morning, the holds were moving and the stories were flowing again. Digital access may be fragile, but the community working behind the scenes is incredibly resilient.
